purpose: Trace research questions and optional runtimes without claiming that original demonstration models reproduce published results.

calibration.note: No experimental result is evidence of real seven-day matching, merchant participation, or physical fulfillment until calibrated and prospectively checked against pilot data.

reproducibility.version_policy: Exact reviewed runtime pins; update the lock, source record, and behavioral validation together.
reproducibility.adapter_integration: Independent JSON demonstrations; neither adapter currently drives the core marketplace engine.

papers.title: When to Match: A Cost-Balancing Principle for Dynamic Markets
papers.use: Motivates comparing immediate clearing and batching when waiting trades off against market thickness.
papers.evidence: The paper proves a factor-two cost guarantee for its balanced finite arrival model and reports application experiments.
assumptions_and_limits: The stated guarantee requires equal totals of each type and a specific relationship between queue size and matching cost.
Arbitrary B2B compatibility graphs, impatient merchants, capacities, and fulfillment failures do not inherit the guarantee.
The core batching experiments do not implement or replicate the paper's Cost-Balancing algorithm.

papers.title: Offline Learning of Reserve Prices from Censored Bids
papers.use: Motivates recording exposure and nonresponse instead of treating observed bids as an uncensored demand sample.
papers.evidence: The paper studies identification and regret for reserve learning from censored historical bids, with theoretical and numerical results.
assumptions_and_limits: Central results use monotone hazard rate assumptions and information about censored bidders.
Seller revenue in a second-price auction differs from an at-cost cooperative procurement objective.
No reserve-learning estimator or paper experiment is implemented here.

papers.title: Barter Exchange with Asymmetric Valuations
papers.use: Motivates checking whose value is counted and whether each participant benefits in a proposed barter cycle.
papers.evidence: The research distinguishes expected guarantees from the outcomes of randomized allocation.
assumptions_and_limits: An ex ante guarantee is not a guarantee of realized individual benefit.
A static allocation result does not establish delivery reliability or robust execution of a multi-party exchange.
The core cycle model is an independent synthetic stress test, not the paper's algorithm.

papers.title: Operational research approaches and mathematical models for kidney exchange: A literature survey and empirical evaluation
papers.use: Reference formulations and benchmark instances for cycle and chain matching.
papers.evidence: A computational comparison of cycle/chain integer-programming formulations on kidney-exchange instances.
assumptions_and_limits: Compatibility weights and objective values concern kidney exchange, not monetary B2B transactions.
Static optimum and solver runtime do not measure exchange fragility or physical fulfillment.
The source implementation requires commercial Gurobi; it is not installed or copied.

software.name: Mesa
software.scope: Original synthetic participation/response demonstration using actual Mesa Model and Agent classes.
limits: A response is not a qualified quote.
Does not drive the core engine.

software.name: NegMAS
software.license_note: Use current package metadata and the license file; older README prose describing BSD is stale. Optional research dependency only; not part of the stdlib core installation.
software.scope: Original round-based bilateral integer-price strategy using the real SAO mechanism.
limits: An agreement is not physical fulfillment.
No calibrated strategic behavior, quantity, quality, or delivery issue.
Does not drive the core engine.
Upstream consumes unused global RNG draws; use process workers for concurrent jobs. Economic outputs use local seeded streams.

software.name: Supply Chain Management League
software.license_note: PyPI 0.8.4 metadata specifies GPL-2.0-or-later, while the repository license header mentions version 2 only. Resolve that discrepancy before any future integration.
software.scope: Future reference for supply-chain negotiation competition environments.
limits: Competition execution and shortage penalties must not be equated with independently observed physical delivery.
Not installed, imported, adapted, or reproduced in this package.

software.name: KEPSurvey
software.scope: C++ cycle/chain optimization benchmark, separate from this package's small synthetic exchange model.
software.runtime_requirement: Commercial Gurobi solver; authors used version 10.0.3.
limits: Open source code does not make the proprietary solver freely deployable.
No model of merchant withdrawal, logistics, or B2B physical fulfillment is integrated.

software.name: PyMarket
software.scope: Possible future auction-clearing baseline; old package/repository version mismatch needs a separate compatibility check.
limits: No PyMarket code is installed, imported, or copied.
Clearing a bid book does not establish merchant participation or fulfillment.
